overall_summary: Husband-Wife relationship topics drastically outperform all other subjects (1,600+ views vs 100–300 baseline), indicating strong audience resonance with post-marriage emotional dynamics. Generic poetry and sibling topics perform weakly.

winning_patterns.evidence: Both videos targeting married couples ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar...' with 1,767 views and 'Patni Ki Ye Baat...' with 1,674 views) generated over 80% of total channel views.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on subtle, realistic post-marriage relationship moments and quiet sacrifices.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Jis Din Sach Likhunga' got 19 views; sister emotional shorts averaged only 19-138 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract/melodramatic poetry without situational storytelling, and lower priority on sibling content.
